overall_safety_summary: The scene is generally organized, but an exposed food processor blade assembly on the countertop near the active cutting area poses a significant laceration hazard.

hazards.description: An exposed food processor blade assembly is sitting upright on the countertop next to the cutting board.
hazards.explanation: The sharp, uncovered blades are positioned close to the active workspace, creating a high risk of accidental cuts or lacerations.
hazards.older_adult_relevance: Older adults with reduced spatial awareness, slower reflexes, or hand tremors are at a higher risk of accidentally brushing against the exposed blades.
hazards.recommended_action: Place the blade assembly inside the food processor bowl or store it safely in a drawer when not actively in use.

uncertainties: Whether the stove burners are hot or turned on.
